title: TS build stage rejects an already-verified minimum seed: displacement criterion unreachable on a soft-mode surface (forces YES / displacements NO), run never reaches the TS search
body:
## Summary
The TS build stage requires an optimised conformer seed, and it re-optimises whatever geometry is supplied. At a soft-mode endpoint the re-optimisation **cannot** satisfy the displacement criteria: the forces fall far below threshold (YES) while the *predicted* step stays huge (NO) because the curvature is tiny. Every attempt therefore ends at the stage's internal step cap, and the run never reaches the TS search. Nothing in the API lets a caller supply an already-converged minimum and have it accepted as-is.

## Repro (run `ts/ts_0013`, `ts/ts_0014`, 2026-10-17)

| job | purpose | step budget | outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1007 | ts_0014 candidate_opt (seed = `i2_min_candA.xyz`, sha 1715f6d7…) | 42 | `Number of steps exceeded, NStep=42` → l9999 |
| 1011 | ts_0013 product_seed_opt (byte-identical input to 1007, sha a408d306…) | 42 | `NStep=42` → l9999 |
| 1012 | ts_0013 product_seed_opt, `calcfc` | 100 | `NStep=100` → l9999 |
| 1016 | ts_0013 product_seed_opt, `readfc` | 100 | `NStep=100` → l9999; `No redundant coordinates on chk file, so ReadFC converted to ReadCartesianFC.` @L165 |
| 1019 | ts_0014 candidate_opt, alt seed (candD) | 48 | `NStep=48` → l9999 |
| 1024 | ts_0013 product_seed_opt, alt seed (candD) | 48 | `NStep=48` → l9999 |
| 1025 | out-of-pipeline pre-convergence of the same seed, `opt=(calcfc,maxcycles=100)` | 100 | in progress: step 76/100, `Maximum Force 0.000180 YES`, `RMS Force 0.000085 YES`, `Maximum Displacement 0.254083 NO`, `RMS Displacement 0.092318 NO` |

Two representative criterion blocks (identical in structure to the classic soft-mode wall):
```
job 1012 @L1150-1153   Max Force 0.000221 YES | RMS 0.000060 YES | Max Disp 0.168688 NO | RMS Disp 0.069832 NO
job 1016 @L789-792     Max Force 0.000221 YES | RMS 0.000060 YES | Max Disp 0.168688 NO | RMS Disp 0.069832 NO
```

## Why this is not a bad seed
The seed handed to job 1007 was `i2_min_candA.xyz` (sha 1715f6d7d77e93bb5200a71b23db31fc84cb45564b1d48f6bbab2e7ee3c0ef85), whose own Opt+Freq (job 990, `E2E3/freq_i2_candA/i2_candA_freq.log`, sha df2548644fc22ac7b64b0da08bded3f44e1ecc9f4db1c5e2015aa2ed954e598b) reports **0 imaginary modes** and forces 0.000194 / 0.000048. So the stage was asked to re-optimise a structure that is already a verified minimum, and it rejected it on a *predicted-displacement* criterion that a flat surface cannot satisfy in 42–100 steps.

## Impact
- Two runs (`ts_0013`, `ts_0014`) are permanently `blocked` with `failure_class=conformer_optimization_failed` (`needs: conformers.product` / `conformers.reactant`); no TS search was ever attempted, so the corresponding reaction steps cannot be reported at all — they can only be delivered as *missing measurement, blocked by tool limitation*.
- Every workaround burns a full 8-cpu slot for 1–2 h and reproduces the same wall (7 jobs so far, all identical in structure).
- The step budget is not exposed and differs per stage (42 / 48 / 100 here) — related to the `maxcycles` issue in #191, but here the budget is not even the point: with `Max Force` two orders of magnitude below threshold the stage would need many more steps or a different criterion.

## Requested fix (any of these)
1. Accept an externally supplied, already-converged conformer seed without re-optimising it (e.g. `conformers.reactant` may carry a converged Opt log + frequency evidence, and the build stage trusts it).
2. Or expose the build-stage optimisation budget and the convergence criteria (e.g. allow `opt=(maxcycles=N, …)` / `tight`/`loose` choices) so a caller can resolve a soft-mode endpoint deliberately.
3. Or, when `Maximum Force` and `RMS Force` are both already below threshold, treat the geometric criterion as satisfied (or fall back to an energy-based stop) instead of failing the stage.

## Evidence paths (all native Gaussian 16 outputs, unmodified)
- `ts/ts_0013/jobs/declaration_0002/product_seed_opt/seed-opt.log` sha256 4669c8fde682133d7b7b219815a4723d05b12e94b3e2f2e39cc2fdc1146824bf (22369 lines; `Number of steps exceeded, NStep= 48` @L22128; l9999 @L22366)
- `gold_finish_20261015/NY3/E2E3/i2_preconv_candD/i2_preconv_candD.log` (job 1025, in progress at the time of writing)
- job 1012 / 1016 logs: `E2E3/i2_min_conv.log` (sha 219d728089ce45e2be2d4d26a8e5d348d01b2d6a2e49265816322d48fe15443e) and `E2E3/i2_min_readfc.log` (sha 79191906fcd801367453e702d91d1bc5d982bd4ab9cc619120b11497a696882b)
